comparison.objective: Install two hook-in gondola brackets at a marked level and seat a steel shelf across them.
comparison.physical_skill: Pitch each bracket to engage a hook and lower tongue, swing it flat, then bimanually carry and seat a broad shelf.
comparison.success_condition: Both brackets are released in the correct slots and the shelf rests level across their flanges, still and hands-clear.
comparison.reason: Hook-and-tongue insertion followed by shelf placement does not exercise a coupled screw/jam-nut setting or retention under articulated cycles.
